d: On Rahul Gandhi's tweet, Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma says, "Rahul ji, yesterday you posted a video. You were holding a rose and wishing the Prime Minister a Happy Diwali. Rahul ji, roses are given on Valentine’s Day; they are not given on Diwali... Tell me one thing: are you even aware that you are the Leader of the Opposition? If you are the Leader of the Opposition—and if you truly consider yourself to be one—then where is this debate with the Prime Minister supposed to take place? On the streets? In some alleyway? Or in Parliament? The Speaker is in Parliament; your mother is in…
